messages:
Maya: hey team, first day! okta kicked me back to a device trust loop asking for a passkey but my yubikey shipment hasn’t arrived yet. also no 1Password invite at maya.r@redwood.com :wave:
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Maya! Provisioning started. Current state: Okta user created, device trust pending, Google Drive share pending, 1Password seat pending.
Ethan (IT): hi @Maya — can you describe the exact error? is it a QR for passkey registration or a browser prompt? which browser are you using?
Maya: it shows a QR and a button "finish on phone". I tried Chrome on macOS and it errors with "No available authenticators" when I click use a security key.
Ethan (IT): sounds like the browser can't use the OS passkey API. temporary workaround: I can enable a time-limited TOTP so you can finish onboarding. security policy allows a 12h window for new hires if approved by People Ops.
Sam (People Ops): approving 12h TOTP for maya.r@redwood.com. please note the window will be recorded. Sam to confirm yubikey shipment tracking after IT confirms device record.
Ethan (IT): enabled temporary TOTP. command: `/tools/authz enable-totp --user=maya.r@redwood.com --duration=12h --note="new hire temporary"`
Ethan (IT): also manually pushed Drive ACL for the "eng" shared drive and forced group sync for 1Password mapping. webhook replay queued.
Maya: thanks — I can log into GitHub and Jira now using TOTP. still no 1Password email though.
Ethan (IT): gave a manual 1Password invite: INV-3412. If it doesn’t hit inbox, check spam or the promotions tab. I will also assign a seat from the admin panel if it fails.
Nora: welcome @Maya :tada: I can pair for a quick repo tour once your access is stable.
Maya: saw the 1Password invite, setting master password now. also got Drive link. thanks everyone.
Sam (People Ops): I submitted the hardware request for a YubiKey and sent tracking to maya.r@redwood.com. ETA tomorrow.
Ethan (IT): follow-up: please register your hardware in Okta when it arrives and then we will revoke the temporary TOTP. command to revoke: `/tools/authz disable-totp --user=maya.r@redwood.com` once passkey shows active.
Onboarding Bot: provisioning summary: Okta access OK (temporary TOTP), Drive access OK, 1Password seat active, hardware registration pending. Ticket will auto-close in 3h if unchanged.
Maya: great, thanks all! appreciate the quick responses :smile:
